name: Western company team
description: A tank platoon with a mechanised platoon cross-attached: the balanced team NATO armies fought in, four squads riding four carriers (three rifle squads and the weapons squad's carrier, as a mechanised platoon had) beside three tanks.

name: Soviet motor rifle company
description: Infantry-heavy: a motor rifle company of three platoons, a squad to each of nine open-topped carriers, with a tank platoon attached for the attack. Its tanks lead: a force deploys in the order it is listed.

name: Soviet tank company
description: Armour-heavy: four tanks with a motor rifle section riding along. The tank division fielded about twelve tanks to every rifle platoon.

name: Western armored cavalry troop
description: Eyes first: scout cars and a light tank section screening, a medium tank and a mechanised section behind them.

name: Covering force
description: Built to trade ground for time: tank destroyers to make an advance pay for every bound, tanks to cover the withdrawal, a squad to hold the ground in between.
